'''Scott Rabelle''' is a widely renowned as the founder of Resonance Curve Theory and inventor of the [[Rabelle's Curve]], a classification system for [[Resonator]]s. He originally hails from [[New Federation]], but moved to [[Lilyland]] to spend his remaining days there.<ref>[[Luncius]]</ref>

==Mentions==
{{Character Mentions}}

==Trivia==
* The [[Rabelle College]] department of [[Startorch Academy]] was named after him.
* He traveled to many countries before settling down in Lilyland. 
* He is likely part of the founders of Startorch Academy.<ref>[[Dr. Scott Rabelle's Address on the Founding of Startorch Academy]]</ref>
